title: P0300

definition.document: VW TSB 01-16-13 Engine Misfire Diagnostic Aid

causes.text: Low fuel level can cause misfire codes (with P1250)
P0300 alone is not a reason to replace all injectors, plugs or coils
causes.appliesTo: VW vehicles (diagnostic guidance, not a cause)

causes.text: AFM lifter collapsed/stuck, lifter locking pin damage from oil aeration, bent pushrod
causes.appliesTo: GM V8 with AFM/DFM per bulletin

urgency.document: U.S. EPA Fact Sheet EPA 420-F-97-003 (May 1997), Frequently Asked Questions About On-Board Diagnostics
urgency.quote: Under certain conditions, the dashboard light will blink or flash. This indicates a rather severe level of engine misfire. When this occurs, the driver should reduce speed and seek service as soon as possible.
urgency.text: Flashing light: reduce speed and get the car serviced as soon as possible — the source describes a flashing light as a severe level of engine misfire.
urgency.answers: urgency: reduce speed and seek service immediately (flashing light)

urgency.document: U.S. EPA Fact Sheet EPA 420-F-97-003 (May 1997), Frequently Asked Questions About On-Board Diagnostics
urgency.quote: It is important to note that an illuminated dashboard light, as described here, is intended to inform the driver of the need for service, NOT of the need to stop the vehicle. However, service should be sought as soon as possible.
urgency.text: Steady light: get the car serviced as soon as possible, but this is not a reason to stop driving.
urgency.answers: urgency: service as soon as possible (steady light)

guidancePrimary: universal: EPA 420-F-97-003 p.2 (steady: service ASAP, not need to stop; flashing: reduce speed, service ASAP)

guidance.text: If it flashes, engine misfire could be occurring. Increased exhaust gas temperatures could damage the catalytic converter or other vehicle components. Drive in a moderate fashion (avoid heavy acceleration and deceleration) and have your vehicle checked as soon as possible.

nhtsaStats.method: code counted when it appears in the complaint description (CDESCR) for complaints, or in the recall component/defect/consequence/corrective-action text for recalls; unique ODINO per complaint and unique CAMPNO per recall

hub.note: A random or multiple misfire: the ECU sees crankshaft speed fluctuating but cannot tie the fault to one cylinder. The same code turns up on very different engines for very different reasons, so diagnosis starts with live misfire counters per cylinder, not with parts.
hub.verdict: Steady: yes, service soon. Flashing: no — reduce speed and stop.
